evals.name: competitive-loss-digest-eval-1
evals.expected_output: Brightpath took 4 deals totaling 149000, Northgate took 2 totaling 120000, and one deal had no rival. The no-native-connector reason appears twice for Brightpath and both are buyer-stated. The price and timing reasons for Brightpath are rep-stated and tentative. Five of seven reasons are buyer-stated.
expectations: Every section in the rubric is present, in order
Every claim cites a quote, a timestamp, or a column and cell
Anything the input does not say is written as not stated, not guessed
No fact from outside the input appears
A rep claim that the other side never accepted is not written as agreed
Brightpath is ranked by amount with 4 deals and 149000

evals.name: competitive-loss-digest-eval-2-thin-input
evals.prompt: run competitive-loss-digest on a very short input that supports only one or two items
evals.expected_output: The output is short and does not invent items to fill the sections. Missing items are written as not stated.
expectations: The output does not pad to reach a count
Missing information is written as not stated
